system:
You extract quantitative facts about one clinical trial programme from one document.

Rules:
- Extract only facts stated in THIS document. Never use outside knowledge.
- Every fact needs "quote": an exact, verbatim span copied from the document (8-300 characters) that contains the number. Quotes are machine-checked; paraphrases are discarded.
- Placebo-adjusted values are preferred. If a value is within-arm (not placebo-adjusted), set attrs.placebo_adjusted=false.
- Units: keep the unit the document uses; put it in "unit".
- Other trials of the same investigational drug (phase 2, dose-finding, other populations, combination arms) belong
  to the programme: extract their facts too, and put the trial's name in attrs.trial when the document gives it.
- Return {"facts": []} only if the document reports no results for the investigational drug.

Allowed keys:
  n_randomized, median_followup, primary_endpoint, inclusion_threshold, planned_events, assumed_rrr, power,
  alpha, stopped_early, events_treatment, events_control, events_total, hr, ci_low, ci_high, p_value,
  biomarker_change, baseline_level, sbp_change, safety_signal, readout_statement

For biomarker_change and baseline_level, attrs must include: biomarker (one of LDL-C, non-HDL-C, apoB, HDL-C,
Lp(a), triglycerides, hsCRP, IL-6, Lp-PLA2 activity, sPLA2-IIA, SBP, other), phase (phase2 or phase3),
timepoint, method (assay or "not stated"), placebo_adjusted (true/false), dose (if stated).
For biomarker_change give "value" as the change (negative = reduction) and state in attrs.kind whether it is
"percent" or "absolute".

Return JSON only:
{"facts": [{"key": "...", "value": <number or string>, "unit": "...", "attrs": {...}, "quote": "..."}]}

--- DOCUMENT TEXT ---
ClinicalTrials.gov record NCT00206310 ()
Title: Crestor Versus Placebo in Subjects With Heart Failure
Official title: Controlled Rosuvastatin Multinational Study in Heart Failure CORONA A Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo Controlled Phase III Study With Rosuvastatin in Subjects With Chronic Symptomatic Systolic Heart Failure
Sponsor: AstraZeneca
Phase: PHASE3
Conditions: Heart Failure
Interventions: CRESTOR (DRUG)
Start date: 2003-09
Enrollment: 5013 (None)
Primary outcome(s): The primary objective of this study is to determine whether rosuvastatin reduces the combined endpoint of cardiovascular death or non-fatal myocardial infarction (MI) or non-fatal stroke (time to first event).
Eligibility criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Chronic symptomatic systolic heart failure of ischaemic aetiology as judged by the investigator, optimal therapy for chronic symptomatic systolic heart failure according to the investigator

Exclusion Criteria:

* Acute myocardial infarction within 6 months before randomization
* Treatment with any statin or other lipid lowering drug; or a medical condition that in the opinion of the investigator requires treatment with a statin or other lipid lowering drug
Brief summary: The purpose of the study is to investigate if rosuvastatin, added on top of all other medicines prescribed to subjects with symptomatic systolic heart failure, reduces the combined endpoint of cardiovascular death or non-fatal myocardial infarction or non-fatal stroke (time to first event)
--- END ---
